name: pragmatic-orchestration
description: Multi-agent orchestration for coding agents: run external agent CLIs (Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode, Grok Build, Gemini, Devin CLI, Antigravity CLI) as independent reviewers, stateful repository researchers, or steerable single-agent implementers via the `porch` CLI. Review ask/code modes (read-only), delegate mode (full-access, steerable, detachable), media mode (audio/video transcription and image generation, editing and description), session-history search, Claude Desktop and Codex app session management (find, read, start, open, archive), and subscription quota checks. Ships coordinator-mode, a long-lived coordinating role with a journal that survives context compaction; stale-data-cleanup, which finds and removes stale data on developer machines by evidence (finished agent workspaces, caches, run output) and returns verdicts instead of a checklist; and remote-agents, for provisioning and operating dedicated remote Linux/Windows agent hosts.
